sonnet.problem: Card 5 in this stop already has God saying He will resettle the cities and rebuild the ruins. That gives away card 9's answer, since a baker can tell the nations won't think Israel rebuilt by its own strength. Both cards also make the same point, that God is the one who rebuilds (vv. 33 and 36), so they re-ask one fact.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.
